description: Library builders whose callback lambdas leave a parameter type implicit. A lambda parameter is typed only when the fluent chain reaching the callback method is proven: it starts at a listed root method on a value whose type is (or extends) the root owner, and every further call is a listed self-returning builder method or the transform method applied to a project function of a listed functional type whose result type argument is the builder. Verified with javap on both library builds (see notes); scripts/mixin_target_facts.py verify-library rechecks it.

builders.notes: Registrate-MC1.20-1.3.3 and Registrate-MC1.21-1.3.0+67: every AbstractRegistrate#block overload returns BlockBuilder; the listed BlockBuilder methods return BlockBuilder<T, P>; Builder#transform(NonNullFunction<S, S2>) returns S2; BlockBuilder#loot(NonNullBiConsumer<RegistrateBlockLootTables, T>); RegistrateBlockLootTables extends net.minecraft.data.loot.packs.VanillaBlockLoot.
